Hut key holders

Six members hold a key to the hut and open it for the others. Their names are on the board by the gate with the hours when each of them is on the site. If you need something from the hut outside those hours, ask one of the key holders and they will meet you there when they can.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
